observations: Photo 0: Black Xbox One X console with a black controller on top, placed on a blue glass table. The console has a visible 'X' logo on the front right. The background shows a blue glass cabinet with laptops inside, and a sign that says 'HILIFE STORES LTD'.

Photo 1: Same console and controller, but from a slightly different angle. The front panel shows multiple ports, including USB and HDMI. A small white label is visible on the front right, but the text is not legible. The background is the same as photo 0.

Photo 2: Top-down view of the console with the controller on top. The 'X' logo is visible on the front left. The console appears to have some scuffs and wear on the top surface. The background shows the same store environment.
All photos have a watermark: 'POSTED ON JIJI HILIFE STORES LTD'.

identity.kind: Xbox One X console with one controller

claims.claim: Uk used Microsoft Xbox One X 1TB storage
claims.evidence: The console is identifiable as an Xbox One X from the 'X' logo and design, but the storage capacity is not visible in any photo. The seller claims 1TB, but no label or screen confirms this.
One black controller is visible on top of the console in all three photos.

claims.claim: no games available now in store
claims.evidence: No games are visible in any photo. The claim cannot be verified from the images alone.
Subjective statement; cannot be verified from photos.

risks.risk: Console may not have 1TB storage as claimed
risks.proof: Photo of the console's label or screen showing storage capacity, or a video of the console's settings menu showing 1TB.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as if it has less than 1TB storage, or as a lower capacity model.

risks.risk: Console may be non-functional or have hardware issues
risks.proof: Video of the console powering on, booting up, and running a game or menu.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not working, or with a significant discount for potential issues.

risks.risk: Controller may be damaged or non-functional
risks.proof: Video of the controller connecting to the console and responding to inputs.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as if the controller is faulty or missing.

risks.risk: Console may have internal damage or wear not visible in photos
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the console's ports, vents, and internal components, or a video showing the console's internal condition.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as if it has hidden damage or wear.

proof_requests: Photo of the console's label or screen showing the model and storage capacity.
Video of the console powering on and booting up.
Video of the controller connecting and functioning.
Close-up photos of the console's ports and vents.
Photo of the console's internal components if possible.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
